# George Ponce Realty

> George Ponce is a bilingual (English/Spanish) Realtor with CENTURY 21 Northwest
> Realty in Glendale, Arizona, serving the Phoenix West Valley. Most of his
> clients start as renters; he guides them from renting to homeownership over
> one to two years, and gifts every new homeowner an American flag at closing.

Contact: (623) 853-5241, george@georgeponcerealty.com.
Office: 16040 N 59th Ave, Glendale, AZ 85306. License SA66163000 AZ.

## Pages

- [Home](https://georgeponcerealty.com/): the four paths (rent, buy, sell, invest) and the get-started form
- [Renting](https://georgeponcerealty.com/renting.html): rental qualification requirements, renter questionnaire, how the rental-to-ownership plan works, credit guide, FAQ
- [Buying](https://georgeponcerealty.com/buying.html): affordability calculator, debt-to-income resources, the six-stage buyer journey
- [Listing](https://georgeponcerealty.com/listing.html): selling your home with George, from comps to closing
- [Investing](https://georgeponcerealty.com/investing.html): first rental properties and long-term plans in the Phoenix valley
- [Homeowners](https://georgeponcerealty.com/homeowners.html): flag care, seasonal Arizona maintenance checklists, homeowner tips
- [Resources You Can Use](https://georgeponcerealty.com/network.html): vetted local businesses George refers personally
- [Meet George](https://georgeponcerealty.com/about.html): his story and how he works
- [Spanish site](https://georgeponcerealty.com/es/): every page fully in Spanish
